title: Insurance claims to test Altman and Amodei liability for ‘rogue’ AI
source_used: none readable: the Financial Times page returns HTTP 403 and no other outlet carries the story
why_it_matters_hint: From the headline alone: the Financial Times says insurance claims will test the liability of OpenAI's Sam Altman and Anthropic's Dario Amodei for 'rogue' AI.
event_date: Financial Times piece published 6 Oct 2026 about 04:00 UTC; the claims and cases it refers to are not known
notes: Headline only. The prefetched FT page was a 403 error (146 characters of boilerplate) and six Google News searches (insurance, rogue AI, Altman, Amodei, liability, underwriters) found no other outlet carrying this story, so no facts beyond the headline are available. Related but different pieces, not used for facts: the FT's 4 Oct 'Legal risks pile up for Altman as OpenAI uncovers dozens of hacks' (relayed by thenews.com.pk) and The Times of 5 Oct 'Who will put the brake on AI? Count on lawyers and underwriters'. Whose liability (personal or company) and what claims are meant cannot be told from the headline. Roles of Altman and Amodei (chief executives of OpenAI and Anthropic) come from the Reuters and BBC articles read today.
